My research centres on genetic technologies for insect control, microbiome-mediated traits, and the experimental workflows that connect laboratory biology with real-world applications.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.section-card}
### Genetic technologies

I study gene drives, transgene design, and other molecular tools for controlling pest and vector insect species.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.section-card}
### Host-microbe interactions

I investigate how insect microbiomes shape development, physiology, behaviour, and evolutionary outcomes.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.section-card}
### Translational biology

My work combines experimental genetics, quantitative analysis, and collaborative teaching to make modern biology more usable and more reproducible.
:::
:::

:::
